investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (550) was observed from the user Aleksei.Ivanov@globalcorp.ee, which is higher than the 24-hour baseline of 120 files. Downloads appear to target the Engineering Repo Backups site on SharePoint Online, with sample files including code assets and a standard browser user agent, suggesting typical project-related activity. The source IP shows no known malicious reputation and the destination is a legitimate Microsoft SharePoint endpoint; no prior similar alerts were found, so the activity is more consistent with legitimate bulk access rather than a directed exfiltration attempt, and is deemed Low Priority.
